theory.title: Exercise 2.3.5: Boolean Logic
theory.content:
🔗 Combining Conditions

MENTOR-9: "PROTO-7, single conditions are simple. But reality is complex. You need power >50 AND temp <80. Or sensors OK OR backup active."

"Boolean logic - AND, OR, NOT - lets you combine conditions into sophisticated decision-making."

🧮 Boolean Operators

AND - ALL conditions must be TRUE

  • ✅ TRUE and TRUE → TRUE
  • ❌ TRUE and FALSE → FALSE
  • ❌ FALSE and FALSE → FALSE

OR - AT LEAST ONE condition must be TRUE

  • ✅ TRUE or FALSE → TRUE
  • ✅ TRUE or TRUE → TRUE
  • ❌ FALSE or FALSE → FALSE

NOT - Inverts the condition

  • ✅ not FALSE → TRUE
  • ❌ not TRUE → FALSE

📝 Boolean Logic Examples

*** Test Cases ***
Boolean Examples
    ${temp}=    Set Variable    72
    ${power}=    Set Variable    85
    ${alarm}=    Set Variable    ${FALSE}
    
    # AND - Both must be TRUE
    IF    ${temp} < 80 and ${power} > 50
        Log    Safe operation
    END
    
    # OR - At least one TRUE
    IF    ${power} > 90 or ${temp} > 100
        Log    Warning condition
    END
    
    # NOT - Inverts condition
    IF    not ${alarm}
        Log    No alarms active
    END
    
    # Combined
    IF    (${temp} > 70 and ${power} < 60) or ${alarm}
        Log    Caution needed
    END

📋 Boolean Logic Rules

  • 🔹 Lowercase: Use 'and', 'or', 'not' (not AND/OR/NOT)
  • 🔹 Spacing: Spaces around operators
  • 🔹 Parentheses: Group complex logic (A and B) or C
  • 🔹 Priority: NOT > AND > OR (use parentheses for clarity)
  • 🔹 Short-circuit: AND stops at first FALSE, OR stops at first TRUE

🎯 Your Task

Create three complex conditions: one with AND (both must pass), one with OR (either passes), one with NOT (inverts). Master boolean logic!
